tagline: Hang bounties on their hero, then get paid every time you connect

featuredCards.title: Rule with Respect
featuredCards.caption: The deck never has to wait on a draw. Dig a BOUNTY out of deck or discard and the whole plan starts on your terms.

featuredCards.title: Bounty: Supposed to pay me
featuredCards.caption: Play it and it does not go to the discard — it stays tucked under their hero, a debt waiting to be called in on your next hit.

featuredCards.title: Disintegration
featuredCards.caption: Every bounty still hanging on them adds a point to it. The longer they leave the paper on their head, the bigger the number gets.

featuredCards.title: Claiming the Bounty
featuredCards.caption: Collection day. Every tucked effect fires at once and it hands the action back, so the hunt keeps moving after the payout.
